state: inning (capped), half, home-minus-away score difference (capped), outs, 3-bit base state
state_excludes: the teams, the batter, the pitcher, the park and the count. Every one of them matters to a real win probability and every one would let a manager's roster leak into his grade. This is a league-average valuation of a SITUATION, which is the only thing a decision can be fairly scored against.

feed_agreement.what_it_is: the MLB feed's own wp_home_before scored against the realized game outcome on the same plays. Reported as a CHECK, never as the engine: the feed is a black box and a live number that reflects the specific teams playing, and crediting a manager for having better players is the confound this module exists to avoid.

extra_innings_note: innings past the cap are pooled into it. Since 2020 extra innings start with an automatic runner on second, so the 10th is a structurally different game; it is pooled rather than modelled, and no decision family should read a capped-inning cell without saying so.
